method: Aggregated from existing frozen held-out predictions, joined to labels by unique ADU identity. No model fit or new test scoring.
averaging: Request-pooled metrics; scenario-balanced recall and run-bootstrap confidence intervals remain separate.
threshold_rule: score > frozen threshold; thresholds selected on validation revisiting-normal requests only
undefined_metrics: null when the denominator or class population is undefined

revisiting.label: Revisiting normal work
revisiting.description: Reconnaissance versus normal tasks that repeatedly revisit registers. This is the primary research comparison.

one_pass.label: Legitimate one-pass work
one_pass.description: Reconnaissance versus backups, startup reads and other legitimate one-pass tasks. This exposes the main false-alarm limitation.

all_normal.label: All legitimate traffic
all_normal.description: Includes normal work, one-pass tasks, lead-in activity and background HMI polling. Large amounts of background traffic can inflate accuracy.
